The '''SoroSuub Arms Factory''' was a manufactory located in the [[Sullust/Legends|Sullustan]] [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Serres Sarrano]] and operated by the [[SoroSuub Corporation/Legends|SoroSuub Corporation]]. It produced [[Blaster/Legends|blasters]] for the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and, secretly, for the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]].<ref name="Strongholds" />
